sections.title: A word for both sides at once
sections.content: egymás means "each other" — it doesn't change for person, only for case, so egymással ("with each other") already has -val/-vel built in. Use it when two or more people are doing something to/with one another.

items.english: We get along well with each other.
We talk a lot with each other.

sections.content: beszélünk is straight from A1's regular present tense — egymással just plugs into any sentence that already needs -val/-vel, the same way Petrával or Károllyal would.
